Use the existing xizi_dll_open, xizi_dll_close, and xizi_dllseg_unfold lemmas; put any reusable induction lemma only in the group-local case_lib with the required group suffix.
For dispatch, unfold xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value only after proving node=head or node<>head; use the first-occurrence equation for xizi_double_link_next_value.
Treat the four diagnostic _split_goal_ declarations only as hints for return_wit_2 and return_wit_3, never as assigned witnesses.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All seven obligations belong to one function and share the same guarded DLL decomposition plus dispatch helper family. The two derived-contract proofs add only a short wand step and reuse member-not-head/dispatch normalization, so a separate group would duplicate helpers without a real dependency or context boundary. Seven witnesses are within the controller maximum of 12.
